plan: An invisible assassin who appears behind isolated players and charms them.
aSurveiller: Her W (Allure). It curses you then charms you if she hits you: buy a control ward to see her coming.
contrer: Buy a control ward: it reveals camouflaged Evelynn.
Play near your allies once she reaches level 6.
When she casts her R she teleports backwards: don't chase her without vision.
forces: Her R finishes off and gets her to safety.

sorts.P: Camouflaged out of combat from level 6; heals.
sorts.Q: Spikes that hit the first target.
sorts.R: Ravages an area and backs off; stronger on wounded targets.

momentFort: Barely ganks before level 6: she farms to reach it fast. Invade her before then, then play grouped with control wards.
